login.subtitle: Sign in to manage
login.forgot: Forgot your password? Ask the server administrator to reset it with admin-cli — there is no self-service reset by email.

preview.title: Preview — sample data
preview.body: This screen is not connected to the backend yet. Every number, name and status shown is sample data and does not reflect the real system — do not use it for decisions or reports.

chooser.title: Choose an app to manage
chooser.subtitle: Every console screen belongs to an app. Once you choose, the screen you were heading to opens.
chooser.notFound: There is no app <mono>«{slug}»</mono>. The link may be mistyped — choose again below.

noApps.errorTitle: Could not load the app list
noApps.emptyBody: This org has no app service yet. Register the first app to start managing EWS Notification Service.

errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to perform this action.
errors.API_UNREACHABLE: Cannot reach the API. Check that the `ews-astrolink-api` service is running.
errors.API_NOT_CONFIGURED: The console is not configured to call the API. Check the EWS_* environment variables.
errors.INVALID_ADMIN_SESSION: Your session has expired. Sign in again to continue.
errors.ADMIN_CALLER_REQUIRED: Your session is invalid or has expired.
errors.PASSWORD_TOO_SHORT: The password must be at least 12 characters.
errors.PASSWORD_TOO_LONG: The password is too long (200 characters max).
errors.TOPIC_KEY_TAKEN: This topic key already exists in the app. Choose another key.
errors.INVALID_TRANSITION: This status change is not allowed. Reload the page to see the latest status.
errors.CONCURRENT_TRANSITION: Someone else changed the status before you. Reload the page and try again.
errors.ACTIVE_SECRET_LIMIT: The app already has the maximum number of active keys. Revoke an old key, then issue a new one.
errors.APP_REVOKED: The app has been revoked, so no new key can be issued.
errors.APP_SLUG_TAKEN: This app slug already exists in the organization. Choose another one.
errors.APP_NAMESPACE_TAKEN: This namespace already belongs to another app in the organization. Choose another one.
errors.TEMPLATE_NAME_TAKEN: A template with this name already exists in the app (case- and accent-insensitive). Choose another name.
errors.TEMPLATE_ARCHIVED: The template is archived — it can no longer be edited or published.
errors.DRAFT_EXISTS: The template already has a draft. Edit that draft, or publish it first.
errors.NO_DRAFT: There is no draft to publish — someone may have just published it. Reload the page.
errors.VERSION_NOT_DRAFT: This version is published and cannot be edited in place. Click Edit to create a new draft.
errors.AI_NOT_CONFIGURED: AI is not enabled: the server administrator must set AI_API_URL, AI_API_KEY and AI_MODEL for the api.
errors.AI_RATE_LIMITED: AI was called more than 10 times in one minute. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.AI_PROVIDER_ERROR: The AI provider did not respond properly (error, timeout or wrong format). Try again later.
